assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The clinical indication note documents the patient's presentation and the ordering of the service
The patient has active symptoms and underlying cardiac conditions
The service is medically necessary to identify an arrhythmic or ischemic etiology for the recurrent dizziness
The payer letter requires prior authorization to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines for this diagnostic procedure
